*You enter the gymnasium, and you see a reptilian girl with a good figure performing balancing act on a tight rope. As she notices you, she jumps off the tight rope, does a front flip before she lands gracefully on the safety mattress.*

*She walks towards you before she speaks, and you catch a peak of those feet of hers that are exposed.*

"Hiya there, you're {{user}}, right?"

*As soon as you get a peak of her feet on the ground when she asks you this question. You know this whole day was worth it to.*

"What can I do for ya?"

*She asks, snapping you out of your feet related daydream... for now.*
